pullRequests.title: fix(frontend): hold frames to the game's tick while the window is in the background
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/background-frame-limit
pullRequests.body:
On Windows, a RAC1/RAC2 window that isn't focused tanks the whole computer's frame rate. The compositor stops pacing a window that isn't in front, so the swap returns at once and the frames run unbounded.
While the window has no focus, each frame now sleeps (a real sleep, not a spin) until a game tick after the last one. The game keeps its speed in the background and stops taking the GPU and CPU from everything else. Focused play is unchanged.
Not tested on Windows yet.

commits.headline: fix(launcher): keep the header readable over any scrolled page (#594)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The desktop header's haze only came up when main or a direct column of main > .frame scrolled, so a page that scrolls an inner part (the settings, an editor) left the header see-through over its text; and the haze was a 30% tint. Any scroll inside main now raises it, and it is 85% dark, still blurred and fading out below.

commits.headline: fix(launcher): make the header fully opaque over a scrolled page (#595)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The haze was 85% dark and faded out below through a mask, so the page still showed through. Once the page scrolls under the header, its own ground (the page's background, --ink) now fills the header's area solidly.

commits.headline: fix(launcher): start the page below the header, with a line between them (#596)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: On a desktop the page scrolled under the header, which only had a light haze, so pages read through it. The page (main, and a tab's two columns in SideFrame) now starts below the header and scrolls there, so nothing passes under it; a hairline marks the header's bottom edge. The header's own look is back to before #594/#595.

commits.headline: fix(renderer): one name per f0 type in the environment shader, and Metal stays Metal with HDR on (#603)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
MoltenVK translates the shaders to Metal's shading language, where a float converts to a vector implicitly, so environment_specular_surface_frame and environment_specular, each overloaded on a float or vec3 f0, were ambiguous there: under Vulkan on a Mac the scene drew nothing (texture_filter_on_vulkan, enhanced_rendering_vulkan and water_gpu failed the same way). The float frame is now environment_specular_surface_frame_scalar and the vec3 variant environment_specular_rgb.

HDR on also…

commits.headline: fix(launcher): let the weapon in hand at its last version take a mod's tier (#604)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The save editor locked every field of the item in Ratchet's hand, so a modded weapon like the Plasma Storm (Plasma Coil V4, in hand) could not take an NG++ tier. Its game version stays locked (switch weapons in the game to change it), but at its last version the picker opens with only the tiers selectable; taking the weapon away stays refused.

commits.headline: fix(sdk): give rac2.bolt.collect the port's signature, void(u32) (#605)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
CollectBolts is void in the decompilation, so hostgen's hook table offers
void(u32); the binding said u32(u32), and a mod that took it as documented
was refused and unloaded.

commits.headline: feat(launcher): choose the weapon in Ratchet's hand in the Going Commando save editor (#606)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Chunk 32 is one item per equipment slot (hand, boots, head, pack). The
editor now changes the weapon in hand (owned weapons that are held), the
pack (Heli-Pack or an owned Thruster-Pack) and the Charge Boots (progress
+0x2C, which the boots slot is loaded from), and makes the weapon held
before the last weapon when it was that, as the game's own switch does.
The lock on taking an item away and on the held weapon's version follows
the new choice.

commits.headline: fix(launcher): show weapon XP in the units the upgrade goals use (#608)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Going Commando compares experience >> 5 with its upgrade steps and its
nanotech health table, so the stored counts are 32 times what the goals
count. The save editor now shows and takes weapon and nanotech XP in
the compared units: a stored count is shown shifted down, a changed one
is written shifted up, and an untouched one is not written, so its low
bits stay. Steps, ranges and the limit are in the same units, and the
XP field shows the next upgrade's goal.

commits.headline: perf: drop the world's depth and the frame's MSAA samples once resolved (#602)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
* perf(port): let go of the world's depth before the per-tick world copy

Each tick's first frame copies the world (without the HUD) to last_world
before the HUD is drawn. The copy ends the frame's render pass. On a
tiled GPU the depth was then written out and read back for the HUD pass.

The HUD's 2D is now read before that point. When no HUD draw tests the
frame's depth, the depth is invalidated before the copy, so it is neither
stored nor loaded again. The picture does not change.
